messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — Model quality regression detected for tenant acme-corp (dedicated-pool-us-east-1). Metric trigger: eval-regression > 12% on canonical prompt set. Severity: P2. Paging on-call.

james-sre: Ack, oncall here. Paging handoff in progress. Anyone from ML available?

sara-ml: I'm here. I saw the spike on the nightly canary. We pushed a quantization profile change to acme-corp at 2026-03-15T12:00:00Z (profile: q4_8_small) as part of dedicated optimization A/B.

eli-eng: acme reported poor factuality / hallucinations — example pasted by support: see below.

marta-support: customer note (copied):
```
User: "Summarize our Q1 sales and mention any referrals from partners."
Model: "Q1 sales increased by 70% due to the new Zapier partnership. No referrals were recorded."
```
This is wrong, partner referrals were actually 14% — customer is escalated to account team.

sara-ml: thanks. That example matches the eval regressions we're seeing (precision down, hallucination up). Quick hypothesis: the q4_8_small quant profile reduced certain attention fidelity on long-context tokens for this model, exposing a regression on the customer's prompt patterns.

james-sre: Can we mitigate quickly? Revert to the previous quant profile for acme-corp only? Prefer tenant-scoped revert rather than full rollback.

sara-ml: Yes. We have tenant-scoped profile pins. Rollback command below — will revert quant profile to `q4_0_stable` which passed canaries.

```
# tenant-scoped quant profile rollback (ML runbook)
redwood model update --tenant acme-corp --model ret-13b --quant-profile q4_0_stable --note "rollback after regressions 2026-03-15"
redwood deploy rollback --tenant acme-corp --deployment dp-98765 --to-version v2026-02-20
```

james-sre: Performing the rollback now. I will leave the deployment pinned to the stable profile for 2 hours and then run a full eval. Posting logs when done.

deploy-bot: deploy job 983724 started: rolling quant-profile rollback to acme-corp (dp-98765). ETA 60s.

(deploy logs)
```
[12:05:12] Starting tenant-scoped update for acme-corp
[12:05:24] Pulling model ret-13b:v2026-02-20
[12:05:36] Applying quant profile q4_0_stable
[12:06:05] Reconfiguration complete, routing switch in progress
[12:06:50] Switch complete — 100% traffic on q4_0_stable for acme-corp
```

eli-eng: Initial sanity checks: hand-eval on 20 prompts, 18/20 match baseline quality. Perplexity returned to baseline (+/- 2%). Monitoring live traffic.

sara-ml: Great — run a few targeted prompts from the customer's failing set and post samples.

marta-support: Drafting customer-safe message for acme team, suggest wording: "We detected a regression tied to a recent quantization optimization applied only to your dedicated pool. We have reverted that change and are monitoring. You should see behavior restored within minutes. We're conducting a follow-up and will share findings." Anyone want to edit?

james-sre: LGTM, add ETA for follow-up: "detailed postmortem within 48 hours, interim update in 2 hours."

incident-bot: Severity downgraded to P3 — mitigation applied, customer impact mitigated.

(10m later)

eli-eng: Ongoing metrics: rolling 1h eval shows no further regressions. Sampling of customer traffic looks consistent with pre-change outputs.

james-sre: Handing over to next on-call: @tina-sre — rollback completed, traffic pinned to `q4_0_stable`, monitor for 2 hours, watch eval-regression and latency. Link to runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/tenant-quant-rollbacks

tina-sre: Ack, taking over. I'll watch the alerting dashboard and escalate if regressed again. Leaving a follow-up checklist:
- confirm artifacts from the original quant rollout (who approved, rollout window)
- request ML to run a focused A/B with isolated prompts to reproduce
- ensure customer comms are sent and account team is looped

sara-ml: I'll run a focused A/B and schedule a locked experiment (no automatic rollout) to see if we can tune q4_8_small without degrading the customer's prompt class. Will attach diff logs.

marta-support: Sent customer message and created support ticket #S-90342. Account team acknowledged.

james-sre: Closing incident thread but leaving it open for postmortem notes. If no regression in 2h, we'll mark post-incident: mitigated.

incident-bot: Thread marked: mitigated (temporary fix). Postmortem owner requested: @sara-ml to own review and PR to prevent tenant-scoped rollout without canary overlap.

marta-support: Thanks team — keeping account warm.

tina-sre: Noted. Monitoring window started at 2026-03-15T12:07:00Z.
